title: Squiz DXP Component Manifest Schema v1
description: Main component manifest schema defining the structure of DXP component manifest.json files. Referenced via '$schema': 'http://localhost:3000/schemas/v1.json#' in each manifest.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Use 'http://localhost:3000/schemas/v1.json#' for DXP dev-ui validation.

namespace.description: Component namespace — lowercase with hyphens (e.g. 'ntg-web-design-system'). Must be unique per DXP environment.

name.description: Component name — lowercase with hyphens (e.g. 'header', 'footer'). Unique within the namespace.

displayName.description: Human-readable component name shown in the DXP UI (e.g. 'Header', 'Footer').

description.description: Short description of the component's purpose shown in the DXP UI.

icon.description: Component icon shown in the DXP component library. See component-icons.schema.json.

type.description: Component runtime type. 'edge' for server-side rendering via Cloudflare Workers. 'server' for traditional server-side rendering.

version.description: Semantic version of this component (e.g. '1.0.0'). Increment on any manifest or main.js change.

mainFunction.description: Name of the primary function exported from main.js that renders the component HTML.

functions.description: Array of component function definitions. Each function maps to an export in main.js.

previews.description: Map of preview variant names to preview configurations. Each variant has a wrapper HTML file and a data JSON file.

name.description: Function name — must match an export in the entry file.

entry.description: Path to the entry file relative to the component directory (e.g. 'main.js').

input.description: JSON Schema for the function's input data. See component-input.schema.json.

functionData.description: Map of function name to preview configuration for that function.

functionPreviewData.description: Preview configuration for a single function.

wrapper.description: Path to the wrapper HTML file relative to the component directory (e.g. 'previews/wrapper.html').

data.description: Path to the preview data JSON file relative to the component directory (e.g. 'previews/default.data.json').
